summary: EyePoint, Inc. filed an 8-K on July 30, 2026, announcing completion of enrollment in two pivotal Phase 3 trials (COMO and CAPRI) for DURAVYU, an investigational treatment for diabetic macular edema. Over 480 patients were enrolled across both trials, ahead of schedule in five months. Topline 56-week data are anticipated in Q4 2027. This is a routine clinical trial progress update, not a special-situation transaction. No financial terms, deals, or structural changes are involved. The filing has no impact on capital structure, ownership, or M&A activity. What to watch: upcoming clinical data readouts and potential regulatory milestones.
